findings.summary: crates/app/src/main.rs fetch() (Verify round 1): the snapshot request has no timeout; a read the server never answers stays in flight forever and the board freezes.
findings.reason: The app reads with ureq and timeout_global(20 s) (main.rs fetch), and board_app::Reads gives up on an unanswered read so the next starts when due. Live: against a listener that accepts and never answers, the app sent a read every ~30 s (16:22:13, :44, 16:23:14, :45) and after 100 s held no open socket to it.

findings.summary: crates/app/src/main.rs:34: the snapshot GET still has no timeout (constitution: every call that leaves the process has one); each given-up read leaves its ehttp thread and socket alive.
findings.reason: Same fix: ehttp replaced by ureq with a 20 s global timeout, so the call itself ends. Observed 0 board-app sockets to the held listener after 4 reads.

findings.summary: crates/app/src/main.rs:58: Refresh does nothing while a read under 20 s old is unanswered, with no sign on screen.
findings.reason: While Reads::waiting the button is disabled and reads 'Reading…'.

findings.summary: crates/app/src/lib.rs:41-48: finish() drops every answer except the latest read's, even a good one when the latest hangs.
findings.reason: finish() takes any answer newer than the last answered read; the test covers a given-up read's answer counting while a later read is still waiting.
